response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus

assumptions.assumption: "passes the 47.6 cutoff" is interpreted as bandwidth usage >= 47.6 (meets or exceeds the threshold)

alternatives.interpretation: "passes the cutoff" could mean strictly exceeds 47.6, using > instead of >=
